restLayout.placement: left clear floor beside desk grid; manager private slot unchanged

restLayout.overflow: own desk when full; no extra room height

memberLounge.origin: room logical coordinates [0, deskGridBottom + gapAfterGrid]; deskGridBottom=max(podTop+renderedPodHeight), excluding walkers/effects

rug.selection: long for width>=1456; medium for width>=1176; short for width>=896; narrower: scale entire lounge uniformly to fit width-96
rug.alignment: horizontal center in room, keep original variant width; no stretch

memberLounge.overflow: remain at own desk in phone or sleeping state; no floor seating

arrivalAnchor.transition: crossfade at slot seat; away frame hip placed at seat; walking feet target=seat+[0,64]; never interpolate incompatible frame anchors

memberLounge.disabledReason: replaced by leftLounge; do not draw bottom rug/strip

managerSlot.origin: lead desk sourceBox top-left in background-native logical coordinates; transform exactly like lead desk
managerSlot.occupancy: orchestrator only; never consumes member lounge slot
managerSlot.fallback: own desk if blocked; never floor

leftLounge.origin: room top-left, logical world pixels; background-native pixels must first be scaled to canvas
leftLounge.roomHeightPolicy: base canvas only; never append memberLounge height
leftLounge.walkingRule: reserved foot-center lane between bag right edge276 and nearest pod left340/350; do not allocate furniture here
leftLounge.overflow: rest at own desk; never share slot
leftLounge.drawOrder: sort complete beanbag-back -> actor -> beanbag-front groups by slot topLeft.y ascending
leftLounge.protectedActorRegion: face and cup above local y=130; next occupied group starts near local y=160 or lower

keyboardAlignment.offsetUnits: desk logical pixels; applied only to named state after actorStateYOffset
keyboardAlignment.framePolicy: constant per actor across all 4 working frames; no per-frame jitter correction
keyboardAlignment.draw: body -> full tabletop/keyboard -> hand source rectangles; hands share exactly the same actor transform

attention.position: current rendered pose headTopCenter + [0,-10] logical px; never station foot minus fixed height

flame_aura.target: upper back and shoulders, slightly left of torso center
flame_aura.layer: behind actor, then actor drawn once
flame_aura.clipPolicy: exclude monitor/keyboard/nameplate foreground only; NEVER intersect with actor opaque silhouette or redraw torso on top of a clipped narrow sliver
flame_aura.positionFormula: current pose frame top-left + [44,166]*actorScale - [64,144]*actorScale; never use desk seat or hand center as effect anchor

zzz.position: current pose head upper-left empty space; avoid monitor bounding box

furnitureProportions.units: logical px; ratios use FULL actor frame display height, not head height or clipped upper body
furnitureProportions.uniformScaleFormula: moduleScale = targetActorFrameHeight / referenceActorFrameHeight; multiply ALL furniture dimensions, seat, keyboard rect, actor offsets and actorHeight by moduleScale
furnitureProportions.forbidden: shrinking actor independently while retaining native furniture size

lead.placement: uniformly scale around sourceBox seat pivot; sourceBox sets placement, not an independent forced furniture size

beanbag.reason: native coherent composite passes ratio; scene must scale beanbag and actor as one module

rearSeatContract.overlay: actorOverlay source rectangles use original160x216 frame coordinates; multiply source coordinates by runtimeScale when cropping runtime sheet, do not change actor destination origin
rearSeatContract.clipping: actorClip applies to body; actorOverlay.clipInModule applies separately to hand/head overlay
rearSeatContract.moduleScale: all new coordinates follow existing uniform furniture scale

armOverlayContract.transform: same source pose frame index, destination origin, factor and actorOffsets as body; never re-anchor overlay independently
armOverlayContract.workingHandOverlays: compatibility alias now contains full sleeves and arms, not skin-only hands
armOverlayContract.sourceClip: entire original160x216 cell; alpha mask defines arms, never use rectangular source clipping inside visible silhouette

backgroundTrim.draw: keep bottomTrim at sceneY+sceneHeight-24; stretch only middle floor
backgroundTrim.legacySceneCompatibility: current hardcoded trim24 already samples the correct bottom band; sourceRect can replace hardcoded source scale for explicit handling
